observations: Photo 0 shows a front-load LG washing machine with a control panel and a large circular door.
On the left of the panel it reads “DirectDrive 6/3kg” (visible on photo 0).
A “Washer+Dryer” / “2 in 1” marking is visible on the left side of the door area (photo 0).
The seller’s photo does not show the machine running, any error code, or any visible damage to the drum/door seal.

claims.claim: LG Washing machine scrap but doesn’t work and needs repair.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the machine but does not show it powered on, any fault/error display, or a test result.

risks.risk: It may not be truly non-working (could be a minor issue), which would make the scrap/repair assumption too harsh.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine plugged in and attempting a wash cycle, showing any error code on the display (or confirming it won’t start).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs repair (worst case).

risks.risk: “2 in 1 / washer+dryer” may have separate faults (wash works but dryer/heater/vent issues), affecting repair cost.
risks.proof: A test showing both wash and dry modes starting (or a clear statement + photo/video of the dryer heating/operation).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: both functions may be faulty.

risks.risk: Capacity/model mismatch risk (the photo shows DirectDrive 6/3kg, but seller text may not match the exact variant).
risks.proof: A photo of the rating plate/model label (rear or side) showing exact model number and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price based on the visible worst-case scrap listing for an LG faulty/non-working unit.

risks.risk: Hidden physical issues (door seal damage, drum bearing noise, water inlet/drain pump blockage) not visible in one photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the door seal/gasket and a quick sound check when it tries to spin (video).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if repair may be needed for major components (worst case).

proof_requests: Send a video: plug-in + power on + attempt a wash cycle, showing the display/error code (if any).
Show whether dryer mode starts (since it’s marked “2 in 1 / washer+dryer”).
Send a clear photo of the rating plate/model/serial number.
Close-up photo of the door seal/gasket and any visible leaks or cracks.
response.reason: The photo clearly identifies an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg washer+dryer unit, but the “doesn’t work/needs repair” part is not proven by the photo. So it should be priced at the worst case for a faulty/non-working LG unit using the closest comparables provided.
